# UKM Graduate School of Business

> Malaysia's premier graduate business school offering MBA, Master of Management, and doctoral programs in management education with research excellence.

UKM Graduate School of Business (GSB UKM) is a leading institution for advanced management education in Malaysia, providing postgraduate programs and research opportunities for business professionals and academics. The school maintains partnerships with major Malaysian financial institutions and focuses on raising standards in management education.
